name: Helion Manufacturing ESD-Safe Assembly Gloves
description:
Thin, form-fitting gloves designed for handling sensitive electronic components without risking electrostatic discharge damage. The fabric is a carbon-fiber weave that continuously bleeds static charge to a grounding strip at the wrist. Fingertips are coated in anti-slip micro-texture for component handling.

Standard equipment in electronics manufacturing, augmentation repair, and any environment where a static spark could destroy components worth more than the worker's monthly pay.
functionality: Continuous static dissipation, component-safe handling, anti-slip grip
what_it_says: The things you handle are worth more than you are, and everyone involved knows it.
story_hooks: An entire production line's ESD gloves test positive for a conductive contaminant — someone sabotaged the gloves to cause static damage to every component the workers touched.

physical_description.visual_profile: Sleek, minimalist gloves that hug the hand like a second skin. The carbon-fiber weave creates a subtle sheen with fine geometric patterning. A thin grounding strip runs along the inner wrist in contrasting metallic silver. Fingertips appear slightly raised with visible micro-texture. Overall impression: precision tool disguised as apparel.
physical_description.fit: Form-fitting and compression, following every contour of the hand and wrist. No bulk or excess material. Designed for maximum tactile sensitivity and dexterity.
physical_description.primary_material: Carbon-fiber weave synthetic blend with conductive properties. Anti-slip micro-textured polymer coating on fingertips.
physical_description.texture: Smooth with subtle grid pattern from carbon weave. Fingertips have pronounced micro-roughness (like fine sandpaper) for grip. Inner wrist grounding strip feels like thin conductive tape.
physical_description.color_scheme: Matte charcoal grey base with silver-grey metallic grounding strip at wrist. Fingertip texture adds slight depth variation.
physical_description.closures: Friction-fit elastic cuff with integrated grounding contact point. No additional closures needed.
distinctive_features: Continuous conductive grounding strip running along inner wrist
Micro-textured fingertip coating (visible as raised pattern)
Carbon-fiber grid weave visible across back of hand
Seamless construction with reinforced palm pad
Minimal branding — small Helion Manufacturing embossed logo on cuff
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3 functional equipment. Ubiquitous in manufacturing and repair sectors, affordable but specialized.
physical_description.cultural_context: Marks the wearer as factory tech, augmentation specialist, or component technician. Signals precision work and technical competence. Wearing them outside industrial settings suggests someone who works with their hands on delicate electronics.
physical_description.condition_typical: Worn-in but maintained. Micro-texture on fingertips shows flattening from extended use. Grounding strip may have visible oxidation or scuffing. Hand-washed regularly to maintain conductivity.
